label: 石头
description: 在 Geometry DSL 末尾追加 rock(radius, irregularity, seed, detail, stretch) 一行，生成不规则石头/岩块（icosphere 细分 + 基于 seed 的确定性顶点位移，三角网格产物，非 OCCT 实体）。用于地形装饰/瓦砾/岩石——同参数（含 seed）复算形状确定不变。radius=基准半径，irregularity=凹凸幅度占半径比例(0~1,默认0.35)，seed=随机种子(默认0)，detail=icosphere细分级别(0~2,默认1)，stretch(sx/sy/sz)=非等比拉伸做椭圆/长条状石头。产物不能参与 union/difference/intersection（同 pipe/sweep/section_loft 的既有限制）。同义 op：boulder。
description-en: Append a `rock(radius, irregularity, seed, detail, stretch)` line to the Geometry DSL, generating an irregular rock/boulder (icosphere subdivision + seed-based deterministic vertex displacement; a triangle-mesh product, not an OCCT solid). For terrain decoration/rubble/boulders — same params (incl. seed) always reproduce the same shape. radius=base radius, irregularity=bump amplitude as a fraction of radius (0~1, default 0.35), seed=random seed (default 0), detail=icosphere subdivision level (0~2, default 1), stretch(sx/sy/sz)=non-uniform scale for elongated/flattened rocks. Cannot participate in union/difference/intersection (same limitation as pipe/sweep/section_loft). Synonym op: boulder.

inputs.name: irregularity
inputs.label: 凹凸幅度
inputs.description: 凹凸幅度占半径的比例，0~1
inputs.description-en: Bump amplitude as a fraction of radius, 0~1.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 整数随机种子；同参数复算形状确定不变
inputs.description-en: Integer random seed; same params always reproduce the same shape.

inputs.name: detail
inputs.label: 细分级别
inputs.description: icosphere 细分级别 0~2，越大越圆润越多面
inputs.description-en: Icosphere subdivision level 0~2; higher = rounder, more faces.
